high_level_description: The image features a stylized graphic design with a red background. At the center of the image is an apple, depicted in a layered, cut-out style. The apple has a dark silhouette with a lighter, almost white, interior that reveals concentric circles, giving it a three-dimensional effect. The apple's stem and leaf are also part of the design, with the leaf being a darker shade of red. In the center of the apple, there is a logo that resembles a knot or a stylized letter "A" intertwined with another shape.
